transcript: If you're ever at a party and your drink tastes unusually salty, do not continue drinking it. Facts that could save your life, the last one is shocking. If you accidentally disturb a beehive or wasp nest, do not run for the water. They'll wait for you to resurface and continue stinging you. If you ever wake up in the middle of the night to the smell of gas, do not turn on the light. A spark from a light switch could blow up the entire house. If someone ever tries to grab you, scratch them, their DNA will now be in your nails. If you ever come face to face with a mountain lion, don't turn your back on it, just walk backwards. If you ever get carjacked and they tell you to drive, crash the car into a nearby road or intersection. Most likely they won't be wearing their seatbelts. Lying flat on your back is the best way to survive a falling elevator. Studies show you get smarter every day if you follow me.
